bio: Among the city's most elegant restaurants, this venue boasts a magnificent panoramic location by the sea: the terrace, overlooking from above, provides a truly enchanting view. The interiors are tastefully furnished with fine materials, providing a comfortable environment with attention to detail. The friendly and attentive service contributes to an even more enjoyable experience. The kitchen is dominated by fresh fish, displayed in iceboxes and starring in many menu items, alongside good meat options and a selection of sushi. Also of note are the excellent dishes designed for two people, perfect for sharing. The wine list is well structured, with an interesting choice of Croatian and international labels, including sparkling wines and champagnes; a surprising selection of high-end cognacs...
